title: A Christmas Carol

Aurora Cultural Centre Presents A Christmas Carol DuffleBag Theatre Aurora Town Square Performance Hall 50 Victoria Street, Aurora 10:15 am Doors Open 11:00 am Show Start Bah, humbug—until the spirits arrive! Beloved by audiences across North America, DuffleBag Theatre brings their signature wit and interactive charm to Charles Dickens’ A Christmas Carol. Join the “nearly world-famous” troupe as they put their hilarious spin on this timeless holiday tale. Follow miserly Ebenezer Scrooge on a whirlwind journey through past, present, and future, guided by spirited ghosts and packed with laugh-out-loud moments. Featuring audience participation, improvisation, and all your favourite characters—from Fezziwig to Tiny Tim—this joyful retelling is perfect for kids and adults alike. A heartwarming holiday tradition with a twist! This presentation is made possible with the support of Season Sponsor Funders The Aurora Cultural Centre participates in the Access 2 Program and supports removing the barriers to arts access for patrons with disabilities and their support persons.
